octor: tools for the octo L1 larva connectome

octor-package.Rd

Settings are R options, so they can be changed per user or per project (e.g. in .Rprofile):

Details

  • octor.cave_server, octor.datastack: CAVE server and datastack

  • octor.cave_token_env: name of the environment variable holding your CAVE token (default CAVE_TOKEN_BRAININBRAIN)

  • octor.seatable_url, octor.seatable_table: SeaTable server and table

  • octor.seatable_token_env: environment variable holding the SeaTable base API token (default SEATABLE_API_TOKEN)

  • octor.voxel_size: Spelunker voxel size in nm (default c(8, 8, 8))

  • octor.seymour_reg: path to the Seymour <-> octo registration file

  • octor.spelunker_url: viewer for octo_scene() (default: the datastack's)

  • octor.segmentation_source, octor.image_source: layer sources for octo_scene(), as they appear in a working Spelunker state. Preset to the octo segmentation and EM (precomputed://gs://fly-larva-sf/octo/clahe); NULL takes them from the datastack's settings (see octo_scene_sources())

  • octor.seed_cache_seconds: how long the seed table is kept in memory

Tokens are never stored in the package. octo_get_token() saves your CAVE token for you; otherwise put tokens in ~/.Renviron, e.g. CAVE_TOKEN_BRAININBRAIN=... and SEATABLE_API_TOKEN=....
